verdict.rationale: Canny is explicitly built as a centralized feedback repository, aggregating requests from customers via a Portal and automatically pulling in feedback from Gong, Intercom, Slack, and other sources, with search/query capability exposed via MCP for LLM-based lookup of themes and requests. This directly matches the story of a searchable central repository for colleague and customer feedback. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of search functionality quality and scale, plus explicit documentation of a native search UI beyond LLM/MCP querying.
